slides.h:
📈 Quadratic Functions二次函数

Standard form → vertex form一般式化顶点式

y=2x2−12x+7 hides its vertex. Rewrite it as y=2(x−3)2−11 and the lowest point (3,−11) is sitting right there.y=2x2−12x+7 把顶点藏起来了。改写成 y=2(x−3)2−11，最低点 (3,−11) 一眼就看到。

Difficulty难度 ●●○
⏱ 35 min · ★ essential必会

🔑 Must know必须记住 · Standard form → vertex form一般式化顶点式
  1. x2+bx=(x+2b​)2−(2b​)2
  2. a=1: factor a from the x2 and x terms only; the subtracted square leaves the bracket times a.a=1：只从 x2 项和 x 项提出 a；减掉的平方数移出括号时要乘 a。
  3. Check: vertex x=−2ab​, vertex y=f(−2ab​).检验：顶点横坐标 x=−2ab​，纵坐标 y=f(−2ab​)。
x2+bx=(x+2b​)2−(2b​)2
y=ax2+bx+c ⇒ p=−2ab​, q=f(p)

🧗 The hard part难点 · Standard form → vertex form一般式化顶点式

Completing the square with negative aa 为负数时配方

Two signs and the factor a must be tracked at the same time.要同时盯住两个符号和因子 a。

  1. y=−2x2+8x+3=−2(x2−4x)+3
  2. =−2(x2−4x+4−4)+3
  3. =−2(x−2)2+8+3 since (−2)(−4)=+8=−2(x−2)2+8+3，因为 (−2)(−4)=+8
  4. =−2(x−2)2+11; check f(2)=−8+16+3=11=−2(x−2)2+11；验 f(2)=−8+16+3=11
Try试一试
Write y=3x2+18x+20 in vertex form.把 y=3x2+18x+20 化成顶点式。
Answer答案
y=3(x+3)2−7

⚠️ Traps & tip陷阱与提示 · Standard form → vertex form一般式化顶点式
  • 3(x2−4x+4−4)+5=3(x−2)2+1 → the −4 leaves as −12: 3(x−2)2−7.3(x2−4x+4−4)+5=3(x−2)2+1 → −4 出括号变成 −12：3(x−2)2−7。
  • −x2+6x=−(x2+6x) → −(x2−6x).−x2+6x=−(x2+6x) → 应为 −(x2−6x)。
🎯
Only need the vertex? Skip the square: x=−2ab​, then substitute.只要顶点？不用配方：x=−2ab​，再代入。

cards.f: First move for y=3x2+12x−1?y=3x2+12x−1 第一步做什么？
cards.b: Factor 3 from the first two terms: 3(x2+4x)−1.前两项提出 3：3(x2+4x)−1。

cards.f: Fastest check of your vertex?最快的顶点验算？
cards.b: p must equal −2ab​; then q=f(p).p 应等于 −2ab​，再验 q=f(p)。

cards.f: Does a change when you convert forms?换形式时 a 会变吗？
cards.b: No. Same parabola, same a.不会。同一条抛物线，a 相同。

quiz.q: Write y=x2−8x+10 in vertex form.把 y=x2−8x+10 化成顶点式。
quiz.hint: Add and subtract 16.加 16 再减 16。
quiz.ans: y=(x−4)2−6
quiz.why: (x2−8x+16)−16+10=(x−4)2−6.(x2−8x+16)−16+10=(x−4)2−6。

quiz.q: The vertex of y=x2+4x+1 is:y=x2+4x+1 的顶点是：
opts: (2,−3)
(−2,−3)
(−2,1)
(−4,1)
quiz.hint: (x+2)2−4+1
quiz.ans: (−2,−3)
quiz.why: y=(x+2)2−3, so the vertex is (−2,−3).y=(x+2)2−3，顶点 (−2,−3)。

quiz.q: Write y=3x2+12x−1 in vertex form and state the minimum value.把 y=3x2+12x−1 化成顶点式，并写出最小值。
quiz.hint: 3(x2+4x+4−4)−1
quiz.ans: y=3(x+2)2−13; minimum −13y=3(x+2)2−13；最小值 −13
quiz.why: 3(x+2)2−12−1=3(x+2)2−13.3(x+2)2−12−1=3(x+2)2−13。

quiz.q: Write y=−x2+10x−4 in vertex form and state the range.把 y=−x2+10x−4 化成顶点式，并写出值域。
quiz.hint: −(x2−10x)−4
quiz.ans: y=−(x−5)2+21; range y≤21y=−(x−5)2+21；值域 y≤21
quiz.why: −(x2−10x+25−25)−4=−(x−5)2+25−4.−(x2−10x+25−25)−4=−(x−5)2+25−4。

quiz.q: Write y=x2+5x+2 in vertex form.把 y=x2+5x+2 化成顶点式。

y=(x+25​)2+417​

quiz.q: Write y=21​x2−3x+2 in vertex form and state the vertex.把 y=21​x2−3x+2 化成顶点式，并写出顶点。
quiz.hint: Factor 21​: −3x÷21​=−6x.提出 21​：−3x÷21​=−6x。
quiz.ans: y=21​(x−3)2−25​; vertex (3,−25​)y=21​(x−3)2−25​；顶点 (3,−25​)

quiz.q: Find k so that the vertex of y=x2−6x+k lies on the x-axis.求 k，使 y=x2−6x+k 的顶点在 x 轴上。
quiz.hint: Vertex form is (x−3)2+(k−9); on the x-axis means q=0.顶点式为 (x−3)2+(k−9)；在 x 轴上即 q=0。
quiz.ans: k=9
quiz.why: y=(x−3)2−9+k, so q=k−9=0 and k=9.y=(x−3)2−9+k，q=k−9=0，得 k=9。

quiz.q: The cross-section of a roadside drainage ditch in the Fraser Valley is y=0.5x2−4x+2, where x is the horizontal distance and y is the height, both in metres, measured from the road surface. (a) Write the equation in vertex form and state how far below the road the lowest point is. (b) After heavy rain the water surface is 4 m below the road. How deep is the water, and how wide is its surface?弗雷泽河谷一条路边排水沟的横截面是 y=0.5x2−4x+2，其中 x 是水平距离、y 是高度，单位都是米，以路面为基准。(a) 写出顶点式，并说明最低点在路面下多深。(b) 大雨后水面在路面下 4 m。水有多深？水面多宽？
quiz.hint: Complete the square for the vertex. The water surface is the line y=−4.先配方求顶点。水面是直线 y=−4。
quiz.ans: y=0.5(x−4)2−6, lowest point 6 m below the road; water depth 2 m, surface width 4 my=0.5(x−4)2−6，最低点在路面下 6 m；水深 2 m，水面宽 4 m
quiz.why: Factor 0.5 from the first two terms: y=0.5(x2−8x)+2=0.5(x2−8x+16−16)+2.前两项提出 0.5：y=0.5(x2−8x)+2=0.5(x2−8x+16−16)+2。
